text:
The Flyers arrived in Edmonton with the week's loudest off-ice story. On Tuesday, ESPN's Kevin Weekes reported that Matvei Michkov would like a fresh start elsewhere; ESPN's sources said the Flyers had received no formal request and have no intention of trading him, and GM Danny Briere shut the chatter down. Michkov played Wednesday, picked up an assist on the tying goal, and the Flyers played well enough to win. They lost 3-2 in overtime anyway.

Philadelphia had the better of the first period, 1.12 expected goals (the quality of chances) to 0.43, and outshot Edmonton 13-6, forcing the Oilers into dump-and-chase hockey. Tristan Jarry turned away all of it, including a 20% look from Tyson Foerster. Zach Hyman scored the opener 4:13 into the second after a bounce off the back boards dropped the puck on his stick, then added a power-play backhand at 14:03 off feeds from Connor McDavid and Evan Bouchard. Edmonton led 2-0 on its only power play of the night.

The Flyers kept coming. Foerster scored on the power play at 16:49 of the second, a shot with a 6% chance of going in, and Travis Sanheim tied it at 11:42 of the third with Rasmus Ristolainen and Michkov assisting. That goal moved Philadelphia from a 16% win chance to 48%. Jarry's stop on Ristolainen late in the third was the save of the game; he finished with 30 saves on 32 shots, a goal better than his shots deserved.

Overtime lasted 47 seconds. Leon Draisaitl found Bouchard, and the defenseman's snap shot ended it, his goal worth more to Edmonton's win chances than any other on the night.

Philadelphia out-attempted Edmonton 66-49 and deserved to win 57% of replays, so this one stings. Edmonton has now won three straight, and while not every win in that run has been dominant, a team with McDavid and Draisaitl tends to collect points on nights its goalie is the best player on the ice. For the Flyers, the question is how long the Michkov story follows them around, and whether performances like this one can quiet it.
headline: Jarry and Bouchard spoil a strong Flyers night
